outlook.statement: Company is expected to increase its margin by 10% in next year.

Having regard to the projections, the Company's future business plans, and the detailed cash flow forecasts reviewed by the Board of Directors, we are of the opinion that the use of the going concern basis of accounting in the preparation of the Financial Statements for the year ended March 31, is appropriate.
The Company has secured materially improved contract values on a going-forward basis, which are expected to contribute significantly to revenue and profitability in the coming periods.
The Company is in an advanced stage of enhancing its working capital credit facilities and is actively arranging External Commercial Borrowings to further strengthen its liquidity position.
These measures are expected to ensure that the Company is able to realise its assets and discharge its liabilities in the normal course of business.
